versions.content: ⌊ DRAFT g Semantics of meta-class BinaryManifestMeta- DataField Meta-class BinaryManifestMetaDataField is used to describe meta-data of a Software Cluster Binary Manifest . This can be achieved by means of the aggregation of BinaryManifestMetaDataField at CpSoft- wareClusterBinaryManifestDescriptor in the role metaDataField . As a part of the Software Cluster Binary Manifest , a BinaryManifest- MetaDataField is represented at run-time by a symbol that is located at an ad- dress . On the model level, attribute category can be used to further categorize a specific BinaryManifestMetaDataField .
